title: The relative restriction kernel ideal is square-zero
statement: For a scheme X and ideal sheaves J ≤ I with I*I ≤ J, the kernel ideal of the section restriction map from the J-subscheme etale structure presheaf to the pullback along the inclusion of the I-subscheme has square-zero product on every etale object V.

proof.text: Compute on affine charts: the kernel is I/J, whose square is zero by I*I ≤ J; etale base change preserves the inclusion and the sheaf condition glues it.
